name: Cavitation / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A fast cluster of liquid bubbles imploding into one deep hollow pop, then repeated weakening hollow fluid collapses, a low pressure ring and splattering acidic water. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
